summary: Arrive AI Inc. furnished a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing an October 12, 2026 press release announcing the formation of Arrive AI Defense, a new internal division targeting defense, military, diplomatic and national security logistics. Chief Strategy Officer Neerav Shah will lead the unit. No transaction, securities issuance, price, stake, premium, advisor, board recommendation or close date is stated; the company only flags potential non-dilutive government funding. Structurally this is an ordinary business-expansion disclosure, not a special situation. Watch for subsequent contract awards, government-funded R&D, or capital-raising announcements that could alter the equity story.
